headline: Diesel is the largest move in the dataset
detail: Median +158.2% from the 2025-09 trough to 2026-05, and it rose in all 37 jurisdictions - the slowest was +115.1%. It also carries the highest exposure multiplier: 0.66 pp of total cost per 1 pp of cost share.
review: Review what share of your cost base is diesel before assuming this reaches your margin.

headline: Fares did not fall when fuel fell
detail: In 81 jurisdiction-month pairs where petrol was cheaper year-on-year, okada, water and air fares rose in 100% of observations; intracity bus 98.8%; intercity 84.0%.
review: Reassess any budget that assumes transport costs track fuel downward.

headline: Location changes what you pay for mobility, not for fuel
detail: Water transport varies 6.91x across jurisdictions and okada 2.32x; petrol varies 1.14x. The whole national petrol spread is ₦195.16/l.
review: If siting is open, compare locations on local mobility. Do not site on fuel price.

headline: Self-generation is several times grid cost at the reference tariff
detail: Diesel self-generation ran 3.9-5.2x the fixed July 2025 Band A reference of ₦209.50/kWh, and was never cheaper at any band or any month. Break-even needs diesel at ₦628.50/l against a cheapest observed ₦1,266.33.
review: Investigate how many generator hours are genuinely unavoidable, and verify your band against your current bill.

headline: Five of nine costs cannot name a cheapest jurisdiction
detail: Air, diesel, LPG 5 kg, LPG 12.5 kg and petrol reshuffle faster than the spread they would have to traverse, so a monthly ranking does not persist. Only water, okada, intracity bus and intercity bus support a durable ranking.
review: Do not set a standing supplier or site preference on a ranking for those five costs.

headline: Headline inflation decelerated while energy accelerated
detail: CPI all-items year-on-year eased over the same period in which diesel rose sharply. A business indexing costs to CPI alone would have tracked neither its energy nor its transport exposure.
review: Compare the specific costs you buy against CPI rather than substituting CPI for them.
